thread:
maria: Heads up — we spotted a tokenization bug in embeddings that affects search for ~0.5% of queries. We have a candidate hotfix that requires a short window deploy. Current freeze active until 02:00 UTC tomorrow. Can we get an exemption + pin? @sam @release-bot
sam: Can you confirm impact and rollback plan? Need a one-liner for exec floor.
maria: Impact: recall drop for small subset; reports from 2 customers. Hotfix is a model binary bump + config flag. Rollback = pin to prev model. ETA deploy ~10m with smoke.
alex-oncall: Oncall ok with quick deploy if we keep traffic rollbacks and deploy-bot dry-run flagged. Add health checks. Ping me 5m before.
release-bot: Policy check: freeze active. Emergency exemptions require 2 approvals. To request: `/deploy-request --summary "emb-fix" --urgency emergency --pin-on-failure prev-100`
rachel: I approve — emergency fix acceptable. @tony please verify monitoring.
tony: Approve. I'll run health synthetic and watch error rate. Rollback trigger >=5% error or latency 2x for 5m.
deploy-bot: Running dry-run: `/deploy --canary 5% --image emb-service:0.1.3-hotfix --pin prev-100`
alex-oncall: Canary started. Smoke started — 2m in, all green. No error spikes.
maria: Canary looks good, rolling to 100% now. Pin set to prev-100 as rollback marker. Adding note to release notes: "emb: fix tokenization edge case (0.1.3)".
deploy-bot: Rollout complete -> 100%. Rollback marker: prev-100. Closing thread unless issues. :thumbsup:
